## Independent review

Follow the [independent review gate](https://github.com/WenyuChiou/research-hub/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#independent-review-gate).
A formal GitHub approval is not required by that gate; applicable tests, CI,
actual repository protections, and merge authorization still apply.

- Reviewed base / head commit SHAs:
- Reviewed tree SHA and published-head match, if using a local snapshot:
- Independent reviewer role, scope, result, and evidence link:
- Checks run, results, unrun checks, and remaining gaps:
- [ ] A subagent separate from the implementer passed the latest revision
- [ ] Blocking findings are resolved; evidence matches the current head
